Fourteen miles long, the entire East Link Extension includes 10 stations from Seattle's International District to Judkins Park, across I-90 to Mercer Island and South Bellevue, and through downtown Bellevue and the Bel-Red area to Redmond Technology Station.
The 2 Line, between South Bellevue to Redmond Technology Station, is open as of April 27, 2024.
The remainder of East Link, connecting the Eastside to the 1 Line in Seattle, is currently trending toward an early 2026 opening.
*   Service: Every 8 minutes in peak hours when the 2 Line connects to Seattle.

* In August 2023, the Sound Transit Board voted for a phased approach to opening the East Link Extension, beginning with now-open 2 Line service between South Bellevue and Redmond Technology stations, followed by the I-90 segment crossing Lake Washington and including Judkins Park and Mercer Island stations.
